notes:
No acting user is named. Maria Garcia is user 7 with hr_profile 7 in org 1, as is the Field Support Team, so the new rows are required in org 1. The case's opened_for refers to an hr_profile while the benchmark's case checks join it to user.user_id; her profile and user ids coincide, so 7 satisfies both readings.
She is not a member of Field Support Team on the seed, so the removal step has nothing to act on and its check is weak.
The policy lists workflow, approval, manual and integration as the only hr_service fulfillment types, so the request's 'lifecycle event' conflicts with it; the seed already stores a value outside that list (service_activity), and the request and the benchmark agree, so the request's value is required.
The task description 'IT Forensics & Legal Hold' (25 characters) is shorter than the policy's 30-character minimum for short descriptions, and the case description does not follow the policy's 'Service: , Subject: , Detail: .' template; both texts are given verbatim by the request and are required as given.
The policy's default case state 'new' is not tested: the seed's hr_case.status values (draft, ready, work_in_progress, awaiting_approval and the closed states) include no 'new', so the stored value is undecidable.
The policy's employment_status 'terminated' has no matching column on hr_profile, so the end date is the only testable mark of offboarding.
Not fixed by the request and not tested: the task's status and active flag, the checklist item's checked flag, the case's opener and the case's coe_type; the new service's topic detail, template and criteria.
